snippet.title: Clean Up Earth - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026 - Edition 01
snippet.description:
Clean up the planet and watch nature come back to life.

Clean Up Earth is a relaxing cooperative experience where you vacuum waste, rebuild ecosystems, and transform polluted environments in real time.

Play solo or with friends and be part of a community-driven experience that can support real-world environmental initiatives.

🛒 Add it to your Steam wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3402720/Clean_Up_Earth/

🌱 About the Game

♻️ Satisfying Restoration
• Clean waste and recycle materials
• Watch environments transform instantly as nature returns

👥 Flexible Multiplayer
• Play solo, with friends, or in large online sessions
• Up to 25 players working together on shared maps

🌍 Real-World Impact
• Support environmental organizations through gameplay
• Community progress can trigger real micro-donations

🔍 Hidden Stories
• Discover artifacts and secrets beneath the debris
• Explore mysterious locations filled with lore

🗺️ Large Cooperative Maps
• Massive areas designed for teamwork
• Turn impossible tasks into shared achievements
